name: Bitter-tomato porridge
summary: Porridge of mắc nhung, a green fruit in the tomato family, cooked for hours with minced meat, sticky rice, and bone broth. The fruit is slightly bitter and pungent, with a little sweet finish.
origin: Vietnam.vn, 2 April 2024. The fruit is described as common in Sơn La.
taste: Vietnam.vn says the fruit is slightly bitter and pungent, with a little sweet finish.
howToEat: As the porridge, with the fruit added at the end.
where: The fruit grows on nương and along the forest edge.
seoTitle: Chao mac nhung in Son La — bitter-tomato porridge
seoDescription: Cháo mắc nhung in Sơn La. Sticky rice, bone broth, minced meat, and mắc nhung last. Vietnam.vn calls the fruit slightly bitter, then a little sweet.
